# The State of RWAs – Where the Research Disagrees

> A cross-read of 63 RWA & tokenization research reports published 29 Mar – 10 Aug 2026. The desks converge on the direction of travel and disagree ~35x on 2030 market size ($400B to $14T) and ~36x on today's size ($19.3B to $695B). Most of the disagreement is definitional: what counts as an RWA, which chains are counted, and whether stablecoins are in.

Consensus facts: ~0.01% penetration of a $300T+ addressable base; ~$15B tokenized U.S. Treasuries anchor the market; institutional issuers now lead growth; DTCC production launch October 2026 is the shared catalyst.

## Data
- [data.json](https://rwaresearch.info/data.json): canonical dataset (schema v2.0.0) - one record per figure with horizon, as-of date, unit and scope; desk positions with defined vocabularies; revisions; sources. The page is generated from it
- [data.schema.json](https://rwaresearch.info/data.schema.json): JSON Schema for data.json
- [data.csv](https://rwaresearch.info/data.csv): every figure, one row each (31 rows)
- [positions.csv](https://rwaresearch.info/positions.csv): the 19-desk x 6-question position matrix, one row per cell
- [DATA.md](https://github.com/mishablank/RWA-Research-Snapshot/blob/main/DATA.md): data dictionary - every field, column and vocabulary

## Reading the numbers
- Only rows with metric=market_size are market sizes; revenue, fund AUM and stablecoin figures are different units.
- Check horizon_year before comparing forecasts: most are 2030, but not all (Standard Chartered's $4T is 2028).
- status=superseded rows are kept for the revision history; filter to status=current for the latest view.

## Sources
- [SOURCES.md](https://github.com/mishablank/RWA-Research-Snapshot/blob/main/SOURCES.md): the 22 reports figures are attributed to, with links
- Figures are reproduced as reported by each source on the date cited; scopes and definitions differ materially between studies and are not directly comparable.

Updated 2026-09-26.
